tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Use when the user asks how much revenue, MRR or ARR an AI agent, AI startup or AI tool makes, or wants real examples of AI businesses in a niche (support, coding, voice, sales, SEO...). Returns AI-agent businesses with sourced, dated revenue (start here). Example: {"query":"support","limit":3} -> 3

tools.name: benchmark_business
tools.description: Use when the user gives their own MRR or asks whether their revenue is good compared with similar AI businesses. Returns where an MRR ranks among fresh same-category MRR peers (rank of N + 1 comparable). Example: {"category":"customer-support","mrr":2000} -> your rank among the customer-support MRR

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Use when the user names one AI company or agent (e.g. Cursor, Lovable) and asks about its revenue, pricing model or growth. Returns one business's full sourced record. Example: {"slug":"cursor"} -> Cursor with every figure and its source. Includes every dated revenue figure (label, value, as_of, sou

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: Use when the user asks which AI agents or AI startups make the most money, or for a top-N revenue ranking. Returns businesses ranked by latest sourced annualized revenue, highest first (briefs as in search_businesses); filters category, verified_only, limit (max 50). Example: {"category":"coding-age

tools.name: compare_businesses
tools.description: Use when the user asks to compare two AI companies (X vs Y) on revenue or business model. Returns two businesses side by side (tier, category, annualized revenue + basis, pricing model, founded, top lessons, growth) and a diff with the revenue ratio. Example: {"a":"cursor","b":"lovable"} -> Cursor v

tools.name: get_growth
tools.description: Use when the user asks how fast an AI company grew or for its revenue over time. Returns one business's dated revenue series, oldest first (as_of, annualized_usd, label, value_usd, source_url; MRR x12). Example: {"slug":"lovable"} -> Lovable's dated ARR points with sources. Unknown slug -> isError.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Use when the user asks what is new or what changed recently in AI startup revenue figures. Returns the change log, newest first: businesses added and figures added, revised, re-dated or removed, each with source_url; filters since (YYYY-MM-DD), slug, kind, limit (max 100). Example: {"since":"2026-10

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Returns one category: count, median annualized revenue (overall, by tier) and members with rank and revenue. Example: {"slug":"customer-support"} -> the customer-support agents with their revenue. Unknown slug -> isError. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Returns every category with count, median annualized revenue and members (slug, name, rank, revenue). Example: {"limit":3} -> the first 3 categories with their members. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Returns builder lessons from every business, each with its business and themes; filter by query and/or theme, limit (max 50). Example: {"theme":"pricing","limit":5} -> 5 pricing lessons and their businesses. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

tools.name: hub_stats
tools.description: Returns dataset totals: business, ranked and lesson counts, counts per category and tier, median annualized revenue, payment-verified share, latest change date. Example: {} -> {business_count, ranked_count, median_annualized_usd, ...}. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

tools.name: todays_feature
tools.description: Returns today's featured business (rotates daily): one full profile, same shape as get_business. Example: {} -> one business record. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

tools.name: get_tag
tools.description: Returns one tag: count, median annualized revenue and members with rank and revenue. Example: {"slug":"trustmrr"} -> every business tagged trustmrr. Unknown slug -> isError. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Returns every tag with count, median annualized revenue and members, most used first. Example: {"limit":10} -> the 10 most-used tags. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).
